notes: The programme's own page is the Parcoursup fiche. For a Moroccan applicant with a Moroccan Baccalauréat applying from outside France, the procedure is Etudes en France / Campus France (see https://www.maroc.campusfrance.org/candidature-en-1ere-annee-de-licence-a-l-universite-et-en-paces), not Parcoursup; no applicationChannel is output per the task. The Parcoursup page states tuition of 178 euros per year, but this is the Parcoursup fee for EU students and is not stated for non-EU/foreign-diploma applicants, so it is left out; the Campus France Morocco pages give differentiated fees for non-EU students (2 902 euros per year in Licence) but those pages are general, not this programme's own page.

note.fr: Les candidatures sont analysées par une commission d'examen des vœux : résultats scolaires (91 %), méthodes de travail, savoir-être et motivation. Votre dossier doit être solide.
note.en: Applications are reviewed by a commission: academic results (91%), working methods, behaviour and motivation. Your file must be strong.
